master.name: rosa
master.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent character portrait for the existing princess children's game. Edit target is the supplied original princess. Preserve her EXACT recognisable identity, facial shapes, huge warm brown eyes, long wavy chestnut hair and side swept fringe, skin tone, joyful friendly smile, golden crown with pink heart gems, pink puff sleeve gown and gold trim, polished richly shaded storybook cartoon illustration style. Pose her facing front, waist-up, both forearms reaching gently down and forward, hands relaxed near the lower edge as if standing behind a bowl which will be added by the app. No shield, arrow, bowl or other props; no text or floating decorations. Her crown must be fully visible, hair surrounding face. Crop just below waist. Center the portrait and fill most of square canvas, minimal transparent padding. Genuine transparent background. This will be the master for color-only variants, so keep pose symmetrical and clean.
